privacyModel: daily aggregates only; no cookies, account IDs, referrers, full URLs, query strings, IP addresses, or user-agent strings are written to storage

events.name: page_view
events.definition: One page-load count for a stable page ID. Not a unique visitor or session count.

events.name: guide_engagement
events.definition: One count when a guide reader crosses the 60% scroll threshold; no scroll depth or duration is stored.

events.name: outbound_click
events.definition: One count for a click on a published, approved product link, keyed only by a site-assigned link ID.

events.name: reader_capture_intent
events.definition: One count for an explicit RSS/newsletter follow action. It does not claim that a subscription completed and contains no email address.

events.name: reported_order_import
events.definition: An aggregate report row imported by an authorized operator. No order-level or customer data is accepted; imported clicks and orders remain report-reported metrics.

liveCollectionReason: GitHub Pages serves static files and cannot execute the included API handler. Collection stays off until the site and first-party endpoint share a supported host.
